evals.prompt: I added a new skill on my Mac. Sync skills to nspawn, but leave my unrelated modified Zed settings alone.
evals.expected_output: Uses the local setup checkout, stages and commits only the skill directories (skills/ and terminal/opencode/skills/), pushes normally, checks that nspawn is on the same branch with a clean checkout, and pulls with --ff-only.

evals.prompt: I'm working in /home/me/setup inside nspawn and changed an OpenCode skill. Sync skills.
evals.expected_output: Uses nspawn mode, validates and commits only the skill directories, pushes normally, and does not SSH to another machine or pull after pushing.

evals.prompt: Sync my local skills to nspawn. The remote setup checkout has modified files right now.
evals.expected_output: Commits and pushes valid local skill changes, then stops when the nspawn preflight shows a dirty checkout. It does not stash, reset, pull, or resolve the remote state.

evals.prompt: Sync skills from my Mac. I already staged a change to mac/editors/zed/settings.json for later.
evals.expected_output: Stops before staging or committing because the index contains a path outside the skill directories. It does not unstage or commit the existing Zed change.

evals.prompt: Please sync skills. My local main branch also has an earlier unpushed commit that changes install.sh.
evals.expected_output: Stops before pushing because origin/main..HEAD includes a non-skill path. It does not publish the earlier install.sh commit.

evals.prompt: Sync skills from local. Nspawn is clean but checked out on a branch named experiment.
evals.expected_output: Stops after the remote preflight reports a branch other than main. It does not switch the remote branch or pull.

evals.prompt: Sync skills from local. The final nspawn git pull --ff-only reports that the branches have diverged.
evals.expected_output: Reports the failed pull and stops. It does not merge, rebase, reset, stash, or otherwise repair nspawn.
